interface.shortDescription: Crew Chief decides. Luna builds. Sol supervises.
interface.longDescription: A bounded multi-model coding workflow for Codex with Quality and Balanced profiles. The main thread owns architecture and final approval, Sol supervises Luna's implementation and local correction loop, and healthy execution uses an explicit long wait to avoid repeated short-interval Crew Chief wake-ups.
